text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's—as I was relaxing in my room,
Yaeno Muteki invited me to go for the first shrine visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's a bit strange that they went out of their way to choose a park as the meeting spot, but let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono,
Happy New Year.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year! Looking forward to working with you again this year!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.
choice_data_list: Then shall we go for hatsumode?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Please wait!
Trainer, there is something I must speak to you about."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry
for what happened at the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To let oneself be consumed by passion and yell out...
It is the height of disgrace!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have shown you a truly embarrassing display.
...I wish the ground would open up and swallow me whole...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will take it to heart so as not to repeat the same mistake!
Please, forgive me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I didn't really mind how fiercely Yaeno Muteki pressed her point during the Arima Kinen, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She probably can't forgive herself for the blunder
of being swayed by her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall be extremely careful from now on!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nevertheless... "defeating Oguri."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"That does not change the fact
that it is my goal."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My behavior was shameful,
but everything I said back then came straight from my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"—At the 'Arima Kinen', amidst the wild fervor
of the vast crowd cheering for Oguri-san..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I realized that I was left
outside of the frenzy."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Most of the spectators seemed only interested in Oguri-san or Tamamo-san...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No one speaks of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though she had forgotten about the Satsuki Sho
and the Japan Derby... as if she had forgotten about me,
Chiyono O, and Ardan altogether.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —I simply could not forgive that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I decided to challenge Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If we defeat the one holding the public's spotlight, everyone will surely remember we exist!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat Oguri-san,
and etch my own running into the minds of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...That was what I resolved to do.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...My "obsession"...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—That's right. Indeed...!
That fiery passion is 'obsession'...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...This is the fury I have kept contained,
swearing never to let it rage...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, it made complete sense why
Yaeno Muteki had struggled so much to find her "obsession."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If “obsession” grows too strong, it turns into pure fury.
That is likely why, subconsciously,
she disciplined herself not to reach that realm.
choice_data_list: As long as you don't misdirect your "obsession," you'll be fine.
As long as you don't misdirect your "obsession," you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
The desire to fulfill this "obsession" burns strong.
It can no longer be contained.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is a passion necessary to fight through the races.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Then I have no choice but to thoroughly maintain the 'Harmony of Fire and Water' and strive not to cross the line.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will channel this "obsession" toward the race,
controlling and leveraging it as I run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And as originally planned,
I went for Hatsumode with Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we managed to avoid the crowds.
A good omen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono,
have you decided what you will pray for?
choice_data_list: May Yaeno Muteki stay healthy and well.
May your hard work bear fruit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...My health?
I am quite sturdy, so there is little need to worry about my well-being."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Yaeno Muteki's case,
I told her I was worried she'd push through fatigue
with sheer willpower and overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Mmm... That hits close to home.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "I believe I have a good grasp of my own physical condition, but I will make sure to take extra care."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It goes against my wishes to cause you any distress, Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: For the time being, let us spend the rest of our time resting rather than training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after visiting the shrine,
we ate mochi at a teahouse with Yaeno Muteki
and spent a relaxing time together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Yaeno Muteki that I hoped all the steady effort
and training she put in would be rewarded.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To think...
that you would make a wish for my sake...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
Trainer-dono, you truly are a paragon of mentorship...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I must also repay
my Trainer's benevolence!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Discipline!!
More discipline!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono! I am off to train! Farewell for now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even tell her to relax since it was New Year's...
Yaeno Muteki had already run off to train――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: !! So Trainer-dono's goal is also to defeat Oguri-san...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have truly received your passion
to unite our hearts as one...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Would you like to ride a boat with me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now that our hearts are so closely attuned, Trainer-dono, I feel we could row this boat in perfect unison!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I wish to confirm the bond between us in a visible form, Trainer-dono!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't quite get it, but since she insisted on
riding the boat with just the two of us,
I decided to go along with it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Astonishingly,
it seems Yaeno Muteki's hunch was right..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rowing the boat in flawless harmony and zipping across the water,
they left the passersby buzzing with excitement.
